title: Sphirus World - first representative slice (house / shore / uphill trail)
brief: Existing Unreal Engine 5.9 project (sphirus_UE59). Use the references to improve world, character, camera and atmosphere of the first slice in place; no browser game, no Three.js prototype. Enclosed Woodland Refuge; natural human motion; close right-shoulder camera. PASS 2 (2026-11-23, world/environment/camera): apply the references to the real map; character movement systems are out of scope (separate work stream).

references.notes: Authority: hair mass (copper messy bob), relaxed standing posture, shoulder-arm relation, everyday clothing, fabric/leather/skin material approach. NOT authority: the face. The approved MetaHuman face (live asset SKM_MHC_Sph8_FaceMesh on BP_HybridA_Player) and the user edits stay; this sheet is not a new identity approval. PASS2: used only to keep the character's on-screen identity; no motion work is derived from it in the world pass.
references.inspection: viewed in full by the agent (2026-11-23), metadata read with r2g inspect

references.notes: Authority (user instruction 2026-11-23, pass 2): house position relative to the pond, forest, slope, the two paths, surrounding composition and large-scale atmosphere. NOT authority: the shape or size of the house itself (the older, smaller house in this image must not decide the exterior architecture; R02-HOUSE does), metres, walking times.
references.inspection: viewed in full by the agent (2026-11-23), metadata read with r2g inspect

notes: R06 (resonance / hallucination state of the R04 place) was NOT supplied: eight images arrived, none shows an altered-perception state. No R06 decision is recorded as observed; the resonance section documents the existing project system only.
